questions.question: On New Year's Day 2025 (01/01/2025), how many total estimated rides were taken on the Long Island Rail Road?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('nys_mta_daily_ridership.csv')
result = int(df.loc[df['Date'] == '01/01/2025', 'LIRR: Total Estimated Ridership'].iloc[0])

questions.question: On New Year's Eve in 2024 (12/31/2024), did estimated subway ridership exceed total vehicular traffic on bridges and tunnels?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('nys_mta_daily_ridership.csv')
subways = df.loc[df['Date'] == '12/31/2024', 'Subways: Total Estimated Ridership'].iloc[0]
bridges = df.loc[df['Date'] == '12/31/2024', 'Bridges and Tunnels: Total Traffic'].iloc[0]
result = 'yes' if subways > bridges else 'no'

questions.question: On January 1, 2024, how many more estimated rides were taken on the Long Island Rail Road than on Metro-North?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('nys_mta_daily_ridership.csv')
row = df[df['Date'] == '01/01/2024'].iloc[0]
result = int(row['LIRR: Total Estimated Ridership'] - row['Metro-North: Total Estimated Ridership'])

questions.question: Across all recorded days in the dataset, how many dates had an estimated ridership of zero on the Staten Island Railway?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('nys_mta_daily_ridership.csv')
result = int((df['Staten Island Railway: Total Estimated Ridership'] == 0).sum())

questions.question: Between 2021 and 2025, which year recorded the highest estimated subway ridership on New Year's Day (January 1)?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('nys_mta_daily_ridership.csv')
jan1_dates = ['01/01/2021', '01/01/2022', '01/01/2023', '01/01/2024', '01/01/2025']
subset = df[df['Date'].isin(jan1_dates)].copy()
max_row = subset.loc[subset['Subways: Total Estimated Ridership'].idxmax()]
result = str(pd.to_datetime(max_row['Date']).year)

questions.question: Across New Year's Day from 2021 through 2025 (January 1 of each year), what was the combined total estimated subway ridership?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('nys_mta_daily_ridership.csv')
